title: Zephyr: airtime tracking in duty cycle
description: Airtime tracking feeds duty cycle. AC: Actual airtime deducted from duty cycle budget after TX.
close_reason: Already fixed - airtime tracking exists in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c:242, calls lichen_duty_cycle_record_tx() after successful lora_send() to deduct actual TX duration from duty cycle budget (when CONFIG_LICHEN_DUTY_CYCLE enabled)
